name: Logitech G502 HERO
description: The Logitech G502 HERO is a legendary wired gaming mouse featuring the HERO 25K sensor for pinpoint tracking accuracy, 11 programmable buttons, and adjustable weight tuning for a customized feel. Its durable mechanical switches are rated for 50 million clicks, making it a favorite among competitive gamers and everyday power users alike.

name: Razer DeathAdder V3
description: The Razer DeathAdder V3 refines an iconic ergonomic shape with a lightweight 59g build and the Focus Pro 30K optical sensor. Optical mouse switches deliver near-zero debounce delay, while the ergonomic form factor is molded for extended gaming sessions without wrist fatigue.

name: SteelSeries Rival 600
description: The SteelSeries Rival 600 pairs a dual-sensor system for zero acceleration tracking with a customizable weight system offering eight 4g weights across two chambers. Its split-trigger buttons and RGB lighting zones make it a favorite for gamers who want precision tuned to their exact grip.

name: Corsair Dark Core RGB Pro
description: The Corsair Dark Core RGB Pro offers flexible SLIPSTREAM wireless, Bluetooth, or wired connectivity without sacrificing performance, backed by an 18,000 DPI optical sensor. Qi wireless charging compatibility and a comfortable ergonomic shell make it a versatile daily driver for gaming and productivity.

name: Glorious Model O Wireless
description: The Glorious Model O Wireless is built around a lightweight honeycomb shell weighing just 69g, paired with the BAMF sensor for lag-free 19,000 DPI tracking. Its ambidextrous design and 71-hour battery life make it a top choice for enthusiasts chasing ultra-light, high-performance wireless gaming.

name: ASUS ROG Gladius III
description: The ASUS ROG Gladius III features hot-swappable push-fit switch sockets, letting users swap between mechanical and optical switches without soldering. Combined with a 19,000 DPI sensor and ROG Aura Sync RGB, it's designed for gamers who want a fully customizable click feel.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste
description: The HyperX Pulsefire Haste uses a honeycomb shell to bring total weight down to just 59g, paired with virtually frictionless TTC skates for fast glide. A 16,000 DPI sensor and HyperFlex USB cable round out a mouse built for speed-focused competitive play at an accessible price.

name: Zowie EC2-C
description: The Zowie EC2-C is a plug-and-play competitive mouse with zero software, zero acceleration, and a time-tested ergonomic shape favored by professional CS players. Its consistent sensor performance and driverless design prioritize raw, predictable aim over feature bloat.

name: Logitech MX Master 3S
description: The Logitech MX Master 3S is a productivity-focused wireless mouse with an 8,000 DPI sensor, quiet click switches, and an 8x faster MagSpeed electromagnetic scroll wheel. Multi-device Flow support and app-specific customization make it a favorite for professionals working across multiple computers.

name: Razer Viper V2 Pro
description: The Razer Viper V2 Pro strips down to an ultra-light 55g wireless shell without compromising on performance, powered by the Focus Pro 30K optical sensor and Gen-3 optical switches. Built for professional esports athletes, it delivers HyperSpeed wireless with zero perceptible latency.
